# Luiz Terra

> Official professional website of Luiz Terra, Head of International Sales at Khomp and an international sales executive with more than 28 years of experience in telecommunications, IT, CX, BPO, contact centers and AI-powered communications.

## Canonical profiles

- Website: https://www.luizterra.com.br/
- Portuguese: https://www.luizterra.com.br/pt/
- Spanish: https://www.luizterra.com.br/es/
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/lterra
- Executive Bio: https://www.luizterra.com.br/executive-bio/

## Areas of expertise

- International sales and market entry
- Strategic partnerships and channel development
- Telecom infrastructure, SBC, VoIP and SIP
- Contact Center as a Service, CX and BPO technology
- AI-powered Answering Machine Detection and contact center AI
- LATAM, North America, Europe and Africa

## Insights

- [AI-Powered Answering Machine Detection: From Dialing Feature to Performance Lever](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/ai-powered-amd-outbound-operations/): How AI-powered AMD affects contact rate, agent productivity and outbound performance, and how to manage false positives, false negatives and operational risk.
- [SBC for Contact Centers: Why It Still Matters in the Cloud Era](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/future-of-sbcs-cloud-contact-centers/): Learn why SBCs remain critical for SIP interoperability, security, voice quality, carrier connectivity and resilience in modern cloud contact centers.
- [What BPOs Should Expect from a Telecom Infrastructure Partner](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/bpos-evaluate-telecom-infrastructure-partners/): A practical framework for evaluating uptime, SLA, voice quality, carrier diversity, observability, support, interoperability and security beyond price.
- [LATAM Nearshore CX: Why the Region Is Becoming Strategic](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/latam-bridge-us-cx-global-delivery/): Why time zones, multilingual talent, cultural proximity, technology and geographic diversity make LATAM strategic for global CX delivery.
- [What European CCaaS Vendors Need from Local Telecom Partners](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/european-ccaas-local-telecom-partners/): How local telecom partners support PSTN readiness, interoperability, market knowledge, implementation and customer success during international CCaaS expansion.
- [AI in Contact Centers: How to Find Real ROI Beyond the Hype](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/ai-contact-centers-roi/): A practical executive framework for measuring AI ROI across automation, AMD, agent productivity, analytics and contact center operations.
- [SBC as a Service: What BPOs and CCaaS Providers Should Evaluate](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/sbc-as-a-service-bpo-ccaas/): An executive evaluation of cloud SBC licensing, scale, redundancy, multi-carrier support, observability, SLA, security and operational simplicity.
- [How to Measure ROI in Call Center Automation](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/call-center-automation-roi/): An executive measurement framework for cost per interaction, productivity, conversion, AHT, automation, containment, quality and customer satisfaction.
- [Brazil Customer Service Outsourcing: What Global Companies Should Know](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/brazil-customer-service-outsourcing/): An executive overview of Brazil's Portuguese-language CX market, telecom infrastructure, technology ecosystem, contact center maturity and operating considerations.
- [How CCaaS Vendors Should Approach Market Entry in LATAM](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/ccaas-market-entry-latam/): A market-entry framework for CCaaS vendors covering localization, carriers, PSTN, partnerships, BPO ecosystems, integrations, support and channel strategy.
- [SIP, Voice Quality and Resilience in Global Contact Center Operations](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/sip-voice-quality-resilience-global-contact-centers/): An executive guide to latency, jitter, packet loss, routing, carrier redundancy, monitoring and troubleshooting in multi-region contact center voice.
- [Nearshore CX in LATAM: Cost Is Only Part of the Equation](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/nearshore-cx-latam-cost-equation/): Why talent, culture, language, proximity, infrastructure, management, technology and resilience should shape LATAM nearshore decisions.
- [Why Strategic Partnerships Matter More Than Traditional Reseller Agreements](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/strategic-partnerships-vs-reseller-agreements/): How co-selling, technical enablement, market knowledge, customer success, recurring revenue and GTM alignment create stronger telecom and CX partnerships.
- [AI Evaluation in Contact Centers: From Demo to Production](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/ai-evaluation-production-contact-centers/): A practical framework for testing contact center AI across quality, latency, risk, languages, integrations and real operating consequences.
- [Customer Effort Is an Architecture Problem in Contact Centers](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/customer-effort-architecture-contact-centers/): Why reducing customer effort requires connected data, workflows, permissions, knowledge and agent tools, not only better service scripts.
- [Global CX Requires Local Operating Intelligence](https://www.luizterra.com.br/insights/global-cx-local-operating-intelligence/): How international CX leaders balance global governance with local language, regulation, telecom, partners and customer expectations.

## Topic pages

- [SBC for Contact Centers](https://www.luizterra.com.br/topics/sbc-contact-centers/): Executive guidance on Session Border Controllers, SIP interoperability, security, carrier connectivity and resilience for cloud and hybrid contact centers.
- [AI in Contact Centers](https://www.luizterra.com.br/topics/ai-contact-centers/): Practical frameworks for AI ROI, automation, Answering Machine Detection, analytics and operational performance in contact centers.
- [LATAM Nearshore CX](https://www.luizterra.com.br/topics/latam-nearshore-cx/): Executive perspectives on LATAM nearshore delivery, language, cultural proximity, technology, resilience and customer experience.
- [BPO Telecom Infrastructure](https://www.luizterra.com.br/topics/bpo-telecom-infrastructure/): How BPOs can evaluate uptime, voice quality, carrier diversity, observability, support, security and scalable telecom architecture.
- [CCaaS in LATAM](https://www.luizterra.com.br/topics/ccaas-latam/): Market-entry considerations for CCaaS vendors across localization, carriers, PSTN, partnerships, integrations, support and channel strategy in LATAM.
- [International Market Entry](https://www.luizterra.com.br/topics/international-market-entry/): Executive guidance on market entry, strategic partnerships, channel development, localization and international go-to-market execution.
